name: @brftech/filex-desktop
description: filex desktop — the filex explorer in a window, with browser sign-in, background folder sync and secure token storage
author: BRF Tech <security@brf.sh>

scripts.build: pnpm run sync-web && pnpm run build:main
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run fetch-cli && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-cli.mjs --platform linux && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-cli.mjs --platform win32 && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && node scripts/fetch-cli.mjs --platform darwin && electron-builder --mac
